description.value: Do Chay is a fully vegetarian Vietnamese restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, serving creative plant-based takes on classic dishes like pho, banh xeo crepes, and crispy oyster mushroom wings. The menu leans heavily vegan with many gluten-free options, making it a standout stop for cyclists with dietary preferences. It is a sit-down restaurant that also accepts walk-ins and online orders.
